title: Cherry-picked nodev_fstype() fix from upstream quota 4.10 (commit
description:
Cherry-picked nodev_fstype() fix from upstream quota 4.10 (commit
00534e79856c) to fix spurious "Cannot stat() mounted device tmpfs"
errors during mount scanning on Ubuntu 26.04.

When quota tools scan mounted filesystems, they try to stat() the device
name from /proc/mounts. For tmpfs, the device name is the literal string
"tmpfs" which is not a path, causing stat() to fail with ENOENT. The fix
introduces nodev_fstype() which groups tmpfs together with NFS as
filesystems without a real block device, skipping the stat(devname) call
for these filesystem types.

Only the mount-scanning portion of the upstream commit is cherry-picked.
The tmpfs quota operation support (quotactl_fd machinery) is not included
as it is new functionality beyond the scope of this SRU.

Launchpad bug: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/resolute/+source/quota/+bug/2152171

PPA: ppa:sinapahlavan/quota-sru-2152171

Steps to test:

  # 1. Launch a 26.04 VM
  lxc launch ubuntu:26.04 quota-test --vm
  lxc shell quota-test

  # 2. Set up ext4 with quota
  apt install quota
  dd if=/dev/zero of=/quota-test.img bs=1M count=512
  losetup /dev/loop10 /quota-test.img
  mkfs.ext4 -O quota /dev/loop10
  mkdir /data && mount -o usrquota,grpquota /dev/loop10 /data/

  # 3. Before fix - confirm errors are present
  repquota /data
  # Expected: "Cannot stat() mounted device tmpfs: No such file or directory"

  # 4. Install from `proposed`
  Enable resolute-proposed and upgrade:
  echo "deb http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu resolute-proposed main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/proposed.list
  apt update && apt install quota

  # 5. After fix - confirm errors are gone
  repquota /data
  # Expected: clean output, no tmpfs errors

  setquota -u root 100000 200000 0 0 /data
  repquota /data
  # Expected: quota limits shown correctly with no errors

Note: quotacheck is not required for kernel-based ext4 quotas (enabled
via mkfs.ext4 -O quota). The kernel maintains quota accounting directly
in filesystem metadata.

Please tag and sponsor.

diff --git a/debian/patches/quotasys.patch b/debian/patches/quotasys.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7f33739
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/quotasys.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+Description: Treat tmpfs as a no-device filesystem to fix spurious stat() errors
+Origin: backport, https://sourceforge.net/p/linuxquota/code/ci/00534e79856c8ce385ea1fdcdc2dcb32b1ed5de6/
+Author: Carlos Maiolino <cem@kernel.org>
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/resolute/+source/quota/+bug/2152171
+Last-Update: 2026-08-19
+---
+Index: quota/mntopt.h
+===================================================================
+--- quota.orig/mntopt.h	2026-09-21 17:15:31.000000000 -0400
++++ quota/mntopt.h	2026-09-21 17:15:31.096413533 -0400
+@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@
+ #define MNTTYPE_MPFS		"mpfs"  /* EMC Celerra MPFS filesystem */
+ #define MNTTYPE_OCFS2		"ocfs2"	/* Oracle Cluster filesystem */
+ #define MNTTYPE_GFS2		"gfs2"	/* Red Hat Global filesystem 2 */
++#define MNTTYPE_TMPFS		"tmpfs"	/* tmpfs filesystem */
+ 
+ #ifndef MNTTYPE_NFS
+ #define MNTTYPE_NFS	"nfs"		/* Network file system.  */
+Index: quota/quotasys.c
+===================================================================
+--- quota.orig/quotasys.c	2026-09-21 17:15:31.000000000 -0400
++++ quota/quotasys.c	2026-09-21 17:16:04.847049014 -0400
+@@ -73,6 +73,14 @@
+ }
+ 
+ /*
++ *	Check whether the filesystem is not using block device as a backing
++ */
++int nodev_fstype(char *type)
++{
++	return !strcmp(type, MNTTYPE_TMPFS) || nfs_fstype(type);
++}
++
++/*
+  *	Convert type of quota to written representation
+  */
+ char *type2name(int type)
+@@ -1353,7 +1361,7 @@
+ 			continue;
+ 		}
+ 
+-		if (!nfs_fstype(mnt->mnt_type)) {
++		if (!nodev_fstype(mnt->mnt_type)) {
+ 			if (stat(devname, &st) < 0) {	/* Can't stat mounted device? */
+ 				errstr(_("Cannot stat() mounted device %s: %s\n"), devname, strerror(errno));
+ 				free((char *)devname);
+@@ -1367,8 +1375,9 @@
+ 			dev = st.st_rdev;
+ 			for (i = 0; i < mnt_entries_cnt && mnt_entries[i].me_dev != dev; i++);
+ 		}
+-		/* Cope with network filesystems or new mountpoint */
+-		if (nfs_fstype(mnt->mnt_type) || i == mnt_entries_cnt) {
++
++		/* Cope with filesystems without a block device or new mountpoint */
++		if (nodev_fstype(mnt->mnt_type) || i == mnt_entries_cnt) {
+ 			if (stat(mnt->mnt_dir, &st) < 0) {	/* Can't stat mountpoint? We have better ignore it... */
+ 				errstr(_("Cannot stat() mountpoint %s: %s\n"), mnt->mnt_dir, strerror(errno));
+ 				free((char *)devname);
